heading.title: Of Contracts, Voidable Contracts and Void Agreements

article.title: Agreement in restraint of marriage, void.
article.content:
26Agreement in restraint of marriage, void.

Section 26  ·  Chapter II  ·  Void agreements  ·  page 18 of the Act
Every agreement in restraint of the marriage of any person, other than a minor, is void.
